definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing dishes, food, or other household items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戸棚|とだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the dishes in the cupboard.
I can't reach the top shelf of the cupboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戸棚|とだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
TYPES OF STORAGE FURNITURE:
- {戸棚|とだな} - cupboard with doors (general)
- ⟦{食器棚|しょっきだな}→食器棚：07097_shokkidana⟧ - dish cupboard
- ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧ - bookshelf
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ - shelf (open)
- ⟦タンス→タンス：05012_tansu⟧ - chest of drawers (for clothes)
- ⟦{押入|おしい}れ→押入れ：01345_oshiire⟧ - Japanese-style closet

ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{戸|と}→戸：noentry⟧ (door) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf) = shelves with doors

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戸棚|とだな} (kitchen cupboard)
- {戸棚|とだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しまう→しまう：03064_shimau⟧ (to put away in the cupboard)
